contractScope: Velour House preset archive visuals. This contract covers the premium interior architecture and spatial design preset.

visualItems.title: Light-Well Residence
visualItems.serviceValue: A daylight plate for tuning proportion, shadow, and the feeling of arrival.
visualItems.requiredSubject: architectural light well, room volume, shadow plane, or spatial proportion study
visualItems.assetSource: MaterialPlate spatialLight artifact with room volume, daylight plane, and material shadow cues
visualItems.semanticFit: The artifact shows a grounded room volume, daylight cut, and shadow map so the visual subject supports spatial proportion rather than decorative ambience.
visualItems.fallbackSubject: subject-led architectural light map with room volume and spatial flow cues
visualItems.visualProofNote: Verify the card reads as interior architecture and light control at desktop and mobile sizes.

visualItems.title: Stone & Linen Palette
visualItems.serviceValue: Stone, linen, plaster, and metal held together before anything reaches site.
visualItems.requiredSubject: architectural material board, stone plane, linen surface, tactile interior finish, or neutral surface study
visualItems.assetSource: MaterialPlate materialStudy artifact with stone, textile, and warm neutral swatch planes
visualItems.semanticFit: The materialStudy artifact uses layered stone, textile, and surface swatches to communicate tactile material direction for interiors.
visualItems.fallbackSubject: subject-led material craft board with stone, textile, and surface flow cues
visualItems.visualProofNote: Verify the card reads as a tactile interior material study and not a generic luxury mood board.

visualItems.title: Gallery Plan
visualItems.serviceValue: A calm circulation study that lets rooms unfold without visual noise.
visualItems.requiredSubject: interior floor plan, circulation map, room sequence, gallery layout, or spatial blueprint
visualItems.assetSource: MaterialPlate planGridInterior artifact with room walls, grid, and circulation path
visualItems.semanticFit: The planGridInterior artifact visibly shows room boundaries and circulation flow, matching the promise of legible spatial sequencing.
visualItems.fallbackSubject: subject-led interior blueprint map with circulation flow
visualItems.visualProofNote: Verify the card reads as a spatial plan or gallery sequence rather than abstract decoration.

visualItems.title: Shadow Courtyard
visualItems.serviceValue: Soft contrast and massing cues for spaces that need shade, quiet, and depth.
visualItems.requiredSubject: courtyard volume, architectural shadow, light plane, interior massing, or restrained spatial composition
visualItems.assetSource: MaterialPlate courtyardShadow artifact with architectural blocks, light angle, and shadow plane
visualItems.semanticFit: The courtyardShadow artifact uses massing blocks and a light cut to make shadow control visible without relying on staged interior stock imagery.
visualItems.fallbackSubject: subject-led courtyard light map with shadow flow and architectural volume
visualItems.visualProofNote: Verify the card reads as grounded architecture and shadow control in desktop Story Track proof.

visualItems.title: Joinery Detail
visualItems.serviceValue: Panel junctions, timber grain, and hardware decisions resolved as one surface.
visualItems.requiredSubject: joinery detail, timber grain, cabinet edge, crafted interior surface, or built material junction
visualItems.assetSource: MaterialPlate joineryDetail artifact with timber grain, panel junctions, and joinery marks
visualItems.semanticFit: The joineryDetail artifact shows panel seams, timber grain, and crafted junctions, so the visual subject supports the promise of durable custom detail.
visualItems.fallbackSubject: subject-led joinery craft detail with timber linework and material junctions
visualItems.visualProofNote: Verify the card reads as custom joinery craft and not a generic texture.

visualItems.title: Quiet Threshold
visualItems.serviceValue: A doorway study for compression, reveal, and the first change in light.
visualItems.requiredSubject: interior threshold, doorway section, arrival sequence, light reveal, or spatial transition
visualItems.assetSource: MaterialPlate thresholdStudy artifact with doorway volume, light reveal, and section line
visualItems.semanticFit: The thresholdStudy artifact presents a doorway section and light reveal, matching the service value of composed arrival and spatial transition.
visualItems.fallbackSubject: subject-led threshold blueprint with doorway volume and light flow
visualItems.visualProofNote: Verify the final Story Track card reads as an interior threshold study.
